'''Johan Van der Meer Tosche Mains''' is a [[Light]] deck by [[Johan Van der Meer]], published on [[Trandosite]].<ref name="trandosite">[http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com/ls75.htm Tosche Mains], [[Trandosite]] ([[Rod Latham]]). Preserved copy: [https://web.archive.org/web/20001216131600/http://www.trandosite.mcmail.com:80/ls75.htm Internet Archive]</ref>
